conceptual assets.attack: An unauthorized bus write could change the prescaler or baud value so that UART transfers are corrupted or cease to complete.

conceptual assets.rubric reason: Confidentiality is at risk because received bytes can be exposed through bus_rsp_o.data at line 217. conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could read the receive register, corrupt the serial input, or clear and disable the receive path so that received bytes are disclosed, altered, or lost.
